scope: Share unchanged Near conservative visibility/compaction algorithm across L0 and Near. Stable source slots remain separate from compact draw slots; billboard and shader arithmetic unchanged.

method.hardware: Native Chrome155, AMD Radeon Graphics / ANGLE D3D11,1280x720 DPR1, Yandex S3 assets, Vite dev server
method.frozen: Stop engine; use same frozen geometry/textures/uniforms and copied instance buffers for both variants. Baseline reconstructs original L0 high-water source buffers; production copies actual compact draw buffers. Compare all HDR and sampled-depth components numerically and as Uint32 bits. Views: front;2000km translation plus90-degree turn.
method.timing: Six warmup pairs then32 adjacent baseline/production GPU-query pairs, repeated entire batch; drain after each pair. Isolated L0 draws, not whole-frame speedup.
method.motion: 64 real engine frames,4000km translation and360-degree turn. Per-draw native GPU queries inside RenderPass, plus CPU visibility-update timestamps. The synchronous resumed frame after profiler cleanup is excluded explicitly. No paired baseline motion; volumes/postprocess excluded.

conclusions.remaining: Item16 remains open: visible Near geometry remains costly, together with volume dust and nebula reconstruction.
